invariants.statement: All API schemas and database tables evolve exclusively via additive SemVer non-breaking rules
invariants.defense_mechanism: Buf breaking check in CI & Expand-Contract DDL scripts

invariants.statement: System strictly maintains <= 3 layers with unidirectional top-down dependencies
invariants.defense_mechanism: Cargo module visibility & ArchUnit tests enforcing max 3 layers
invariants.violation_remediation: Compilation error on cross-layer circular reference

invariants.statement: Every transaction preserves mathematical zero-sum debit/credit balance
invariants.violation_remediation: Atomic transaction abort and error log dispatch

invariants.statement: Account balance updates require matched version counter with zero dirty reads
invariants.defense_mechanism: Optimistic concurrency version column and unique idempotency keys
invariants.violation_remediation: Retry loop up to 3 attempts then return 409 Conflict

invariants.statement: All database queries and API actions enforce strict tenant_id isolation
invariants.defense_mechanism: Rust TypedContext injection & PostgreSQL row-level security
invariants.violation_remediation: Immediate 403 Forbidden with security audit log

invariants.statement: Posting latency must remain within P99 < 15ms under 5,000 TPS load
invariants.defense_mechanism: Connection pool quota, bounded query timeouts, and async tokio runtime
invariants.violation_remediation: Load shedding and circuit breaker trip

invariants.statement: Core ledger engine must have zero unhandled panics and pass all Clippy pedantic rules
Downstream storage brownouts trigger circuit breakers without losing in-flight client state
invariants.defense_mechanism: Governor rate limiter & circuit breaker with exponential backoff
invariants.violation_remediation: Graceful 503 Service Unavailable with Retry-After header

invariants.statement: Every transaction must propagate an immutable W3C TraceID and emit RED metrics
invariants.defense_mechanism: OpenTelemetry tracing interceptor and Prometheus metric counter
invariants.violation_remediation: Alert dispatched on missing trace context
